entities.summary: Don Francisco de Paula Enrique de Borbón y Escasany, 5th Duke of Seville, Grandee of Spain was a Spanish nobleman and businessman who was involved in banking, real estate and other commercial activities. He inherited the title of Duke of Seville in 1968 and was a distant relative of the Spanish royal family. He was not a Carlist pretender, because of morganatic ancestry.
